Hello everyone,
I am in the process of launching VESTA, a new global fashion brand dedicated to minimalist aesthetics, uncompromising quality, and timeless design.
I am currently seeking high-level manufacturing and logistics partners for our women?s handbag collection.
What I am looking for in a partner:
 High-End Craftsmanship: Expertise in premium materials (leather/vegan leather) with impeccable attention to detail, precision stitching, and a luxury finish.
 E-commerce Proficiency: Extensive experience working with Shopify and seamless integration with order management systems (OMS).
 Full-Service Fulfillment & Unboxing Experience: I am looking for a partner to manage the "Unboxing" journey?this includes custom, branded packaging, personalized thank-you notes, and an elevated attention to detail for every order shipped.

I look forward to building something special with the right team. Thank you for your support
